scorecard.rationale: Both arms of a Parkinson diet trial contained cinnamon. A separate distilled three-herb trial in multiple sclerosis reported a group-by-time fatigue effect and inconsistent table details. The endometriosis capsule registration gives no fatigue results. Ground cinnamon itself has no verified Parkinson fatigue comparison. Related cultural/experiential records (1) provide uncontrolled context without changing the open efficacy rating. The 12-odor screening study used cinnamon as an identification stimulus and reports pooled accuracy. No ground cinnamon intake or fatigue outcome attributable to cinnamon was measured.
